title: Generador de imagen cinematográfica
addReferenceHint: Select images in the Library, then click Add Reference.
emptyHint: Describe your shot, select references, and click Generate Images.
libraryAdded: Image added to the project Library. Select it, then click Add Reference.
allowHosted: Allow hosted API models in the confirmation card before generating.
selectReadyModel: Select at least one ready model in the Provider Browser.
noReadyProvider: No ready image provider for this mode. Check Production Dock.
referencesHint: Select @ Character, % Props, # Environment (one), or a Library ~ image — chips show what will be sent.
refPoseCraftHint: PoseCraft is staging guidance (pose/composition), not character identity.
activeRefsEmpty: No references selected — generation will not inject hidden assets.
refsUnsupportedByProvider: Selected generator may not consume image references directly.
libraryAddedOther: Image uploaded and added as ~ Other reference.
